# Hooks

Actions and filters Hardenly fires. See [Extending Hardenly](extending.md) for examples.

| Hook | Type | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`hardenly_checks`](#hardenly_checks) | Filter | Filters the checks a scan runs. |

<a id="hardenly_checks"></a>

## `hardenly_checks`

Filter, since 1.0.0.

Filters the checks a scan runs.

Entries that do not implement `Hardenly\Scanner\Check`, or whose id is invalid or already
taken, are dropped. Ids use lower-case letters, digits, `_`, `-` and `.` (at most 100).
Checks run by group (see `Hardenly\Scanner\Group`), then in the order of this array;
unknown groups run last.

```php
apply_filters( 'hardenly_checks', Check[] $checks )
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `$checks` | `Check[]` | Built-in checks. Add, remove or replace entries. |

Source: [src/Scanner/CheckRegistry.php](https://github.com/creogen/hardenly/blob/main/src/Scanner/CheckRegistry.php)

<a id="hardenly_scan_completed"></a>

## `hardenly_scan_completed`

Action, since 1.0.0.

Fires after a scan's report is stored.

Runs once per scan, in the request that finishes its last batch: WP-Cron, or a REST
request from the open Hardenly screen. Hardenly sends its email report from this action
at the default priority (10).

```php
do_action( 'hardenly_scan_completed', array $report )
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `$report` | `array` | The report: `id`, `trigger` (`manual` or `schedule`), `started_at`, `finished_at`, `duration`, `score` (0-100), `counts` (problems by severity), `passed`, `skipped`, `ignored`, `checks` (`title` and `group` by check id) and `results` (each Result::to_array() plus `id` and `ignored`). |

Source: [src/Scanner/Scanner.php](https://github.com/creogen/hardenly/blob/main/src/Scanner/Scanner.php)

<a id="hardenly_score_weights"></a>

## `hardenly_score_weights`

Filter, since 1.0.0.

Filters the weights of the security score.

The score starts at 100 and loses the severity's penalty for each problem that is not
ignored; one check group can take off at most `group_cap`. Missing or non-numeric
values keep their defaults and negative values count as 0.

```php
apply_filters( 'hardenly_score_weights', array $weights )
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `$weights` | `array` | `severity` => penalty per problem by severity (`critical` 25, `high` 15, `medium` 8, `low` 3, `info` 0), `group_cap` => 40. |

Source: [src/Plugin.php](https://github.com/creogen/hardenly/blob/main/src/Plugin.php)

<a id="hardenly_vulnerability_providers"></a>

## `hardenly_vulnerability_providers`

Filter, since 1.0.0.

Filters the vulnerability providers offered in the settings.

Entries that do not implement `Hardenly\Vulnerability\VulnerabilityProvider`, or whose id
is invalid or already taken, are dropped. Ids use lower-case letters, digits, `_` and `-`
(at most 50). A provider only runs after the user selects it, enters an API key and
agrees to send what its `data_sent()` describes.

```php
apply_filters( 'hardenly_vulnerability_providers', VulnerabilityProvider[] $providers )
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `$providers` | `VulnerabilityProvider[]` | Built-in providers. |

Source: [src/Vulnerability/ProviderRegistry.php](https://github.com/creogen/hardenly/blob/main/src/Vulnerability/ProviderRegistry.php)
